description: Run, debug, stop and restart Spring Boot and Maven-hosted Spring web applications from a run configuration list, the way IntelliJ IDEA and Eclipse do.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running a Spring application executes code from the workspace.
view.configurations.welcome:
No Spring run configurations were found in this workspace.
[Detect Automatically](command:vshoon.spring.detect)
[Add Run Configuration](command:vshoon.spring.add)
Spring Boot applications are found by their @SpringBootApplication main class. Other Spring web applications are found by their war packaging and run with Jetty, or with the Jetty, Tomcat or Cargo plugin their pom.xml declares.
task.configurationId.description: The run configuration this task starts.
configuration.title: Spring
configuration.console.description: Where a Spring Boot application's output is shown.
configuration.maven.javaxServerGoal.desc: Maven goal that serves a javax (Spring 5 and earlier) WAR whose pom.xml declares no servlet container plugin. When empty, `org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-maven-plugin:9.4.57.v20241219:run` is used.
configuration.maven.jakartaServerGoal.de: Maven goal that serves a Jakarta (Spring 6) WAR whose pom.xml declares no servlet container plugin. When empty, `org.eclipse.jetty.ee10:jetty-ee10-maven-plugin:12.0.25:run` is used.
configuration.maven.executable.descripti: Maven launcher for Maven-hosted applications. When empty, the project's Maven wrapper (mvnw) is used if there is one, otherwise mvn from PATH.
